scope: Supplemental headless Chromium Event Timing; no primitive benchmark and no installed-browser/production acceptance.

protocol.finalObserverDrain: Three rAF callbacks then 200ms timer after the final input proxy; no additional keys. Not included in latency.
protocol.matching: Unique keydown Event Timing processingStart/End interval containing handler time (±1ms for timer quantization); each entry used once.
protocol.limitation: Threshold-censored entries remain missing; no unconditional quantiles unless all 30 measured keys match.
